description: This file contains extension methods for the PdfSharp library, providing convenient wrappers for rendering various types of barcodes and matrix codes onto PDF documents using the XGraphics class.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: A static class that provides extension methods for drawing bar codes and matrix codes using PdfSharp's XGraphics class.

methods.name: DrawBarCode (XGraphics, BarCode, XPoint)
methods.description: Draws a barcode at the specified position using default brush and font settings.

methods.name: DrawBarCode (XGraphics, BarCode, XBrush, XPoint)
methods.description: Draws a barcode with a specified brush at the given position.

methods.name: DrawBarCode (XGraphics, BarCode, XBrush, XFont, XPoint)
methods.description: Draws a barcode with a specified brush and font at the given position.

methods.name: DrawMatrixCode (XGraphics, MatrixCode, XPoint)
methods.description: Draws a matrix code (like Data Matrix) at the specified position with default brush.

methods.name: DrawMatrixCode (XGraphics, MatrixCode, XBrush, XPoint)
methods.description: Draws a matrix code with a specified brush at the given position.
